facets.notes: Claude Code 2.1.267 persists imagePasteIds on each user record. Its message splitting and rendering code advances an image-only counter through top-level message.content blocks and pairs imagePasteIds[counter] with that image block. Text, document and tool_result blocks do not consume an ID. The ID is the number in [Image #N], and is not necessarily the local attachment position. Inspection is limited to this binding; it does not claim a complete writer schema or native image-input fixture. Normalization requires a complete, unique integer ID list and preserves invalid-image slots. The conformance fixtures are synthetic.
